title: A registry with an integrated database and an associated biobank for clinical characteristics of chronic inflammatory skin diseases
summary:
Chronic inflammatory skin conditions such as psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, hidradenitis suppurativa, alopecia areata, chronic hives, or vitiligo result from an abnormal immune response. These can be treated by modern medications (biologics, JAK inhibitors) in a targeted manner.
As part of routine care, disease data, questionnaires on quality of life and symptoms, as well as blood and skin samples, are collected in pseudonymized form from patients aged 18 and older. This database and biobank are intended to facilitate future research projects.
conditions: Chronic inflammatory skin diseases (including psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, hidradenitis suppurativa, alopecia areata, chronic urticaria, vitiligo, bullous pemphigoid, Netherton syndrome)

interventions.name: Prospective observational cohort of adult patients with chronic inflammatory skin diseases. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients aged 18 and older with a chronic inflammatory skin condition, such as psoriasis (or psoriatic arthritis), atopic dermatitis, hidradenitis suppurativa, alopecia areata, chronic urticaria, vitiligo, or bullous pemphigoid, or Netherton syndrome, who have provided written consent.
Exclusion criteria:
Lack of consent, pregnancy.
